Overview

Loja is a city in L with a population of 250,000. The Music and Cultural Capital of Ecuador, a southern highland city known for its universities and arts scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
